programme.title: SkywatchTV - The Final Algorithm
programme.desc:
Artificial intelligence is advancing faster than most people can keep up—but what if the greatest danger isnt the technology itself In this thought-provoking episode of SkyWatchTV Joe Horn welcomes national security expert and bestselling author Lt Col Robert Maginnis to discuss his new book The Final Algorithm When Artificial Intelligence Meets the End of Days As AI becomes increasingly involved in healthcare education business military strategy and even churches an important question emerges What happens when people begin trusting machines with decisions that require wisdom discernment and moral responsibility
Together they explore
How AI is reshaping society at an unprecedented pace Why discernment is essential for Christians navigating new technology The difference between using AI as a tool versus allowing it to become our master How artificial intelligence could influence culture morality and spiritual thinking What Bible prophecy may reveal about the rapid rise of AI
Whether youre excited about AI concerned about its future or simply trying to understand what it means for Christians today this conversation offers thoughtful insight into one of the most important technological developments of our time
